messages.author: df9ba0266a9a081f
messages.subject: Re: MSstats installation error
parts:
It seems that one of required package, 'data.table', can not be installed. But, we are not sure about the reason. Based on our experience, this type of installation issue can happen 
(1) if you don't have full authorization in your computer, for example, the computer from company - then you should talk with IT people in your computer.
(2) conflict with some antivirus program - then pause antivirus program and try to install.

After checking two potential reason above, then could you try as below?

(1) Uninstall previous version of R through ’Control panel’ in your computer.
(2) Delete the R folder under C:/Users/xxx/Documents/ (where xxx is the user name), or under C:/Program Files/
(3) Install MSstats in Skyline (Tool > External tool > MSstats)
(4) If you still have the same error as you show,
      (4.1) Start R
      (4.2) In the console (commonly panel in the left side), could you copy these lines below and press 'Enter' key.

install.packages(c("gplots","lme4","reshape","reshape2","grid","ggplot2", "ggrepel", "minpack.lm", "data.table","Rcpp", "survival"))
source("http://bioconductor.org/biocLite.R")
biocLite(c("limma","marray","preprocessCore","MSnbase"))


(5) Then, install MSstats in Skyline (Tool > External tool > MSstats)


Hope that it can help your installation.


- Meena
